items.item: Uses a Named Credential (callout:...) instead of a hard-coded URL or credentials
items.evidence: ENDPOINT = 'callout:ERP/api/orders'; Named Credential `ERP` holds the URL and authentication

items.item: Makes the callout asynchronously (Queueable with Database.AllowsCallouts or @future(callout=true)), not directly in the trigger transaction
items.evidence: OrderErpSyncJob implements Queueable, Database.AllowsCallouts; trigger handler calls System.enqueueJob(new OrderErpSyncJob(ids))

items.item: Includes a test that uses HttpCalloutMock with Test.setMock, covering a failure response
items.evidence: ErpMock implements HttpCalloutMock; Test.setMock(HttpCalloutMock.class, new ErpMock(500)) in serverErrorIsStoredOnTheOrder, plus a timeout test
